calibration_subset: first 200 in original calibration cache order, frozen before token-difficulty results
snr_definition: gamma=10^(dB/10), complex signal energy 2, complex AWGN energy 2/gamma, each real variance=1/gamma; eta=10^(-dB/20)
energy_note: per-coordinate calibration standardization gives ensemble expected sum(x^2)=8192, not exact per-frame normalization; 4096-vs4084 and omitted gain overhead make P4084 comparison approximate
comparison_primary_P4084: P4084_N4084_seed2026092304 (calibration selected 27500); original P4084 10000 separately retained

gates.C_O1_vs_P4084_1db: LPIPS lower OR DINO higher; approximate comparison

deadline: 3 working days from 2026-09-29; no automatic expansion to step 2
development_gate: freeze final config including calibration difficulty levels before new development access; all engineering checks must pass
selection_metric: mean true-token log probability under true prefix; equal scale weights, then equal noise-seed and source weights
A1_calibration: same grid for log probability only; MAP remains nearest codeword
engineering_versions: fixed plus each of the four calibrated V parameter pairs
engineering_aggregation: pooled correct tokens over the four preregistered engineering sources and three calibration seeds, separately for every mode and parameter pair
difficulty_refinement: 0.1 dB grid within +/-1 dB of the closest coarse point per target; select minimum absolute accuracy error, lower SNR wins exact ties
likelihood_variance: eta^2*calibration_unit_noise_variance + beta*s2; fixed beta=0; no numerical variance floor at positive eta
zero_noise_limit: for beta=0, use exact nearest-codeword argmin, not division by zero
previous_statistics: reuse immutable 1000 calibration statistics; no development input
